summary: Frontend-only verification of Phase 5 enhancements: split login, procurement order (Site→Admin→Mgmt→Accounts) with admin-first approval skipping to Approved when no management, Units/Projects project-switch, embedded PDF Payment Report modal (Units + Sales drilldown), role gating for post_sales, and Team 'All projects' column. All acceptance criteria PASS.

test_results.login_split_layout: PASS - left dark brand panel with group logo + 'Real-time visibility…' tagline; right 'Sign in' form; admin login lands on /dashboard.
test_results.procurement_stage_order: PASS - StageTrack renders title='Site → Admin → Mgmt → Accounts' on procurement page.
test_results.procurement_create_pending_admin: PASS - New request via new-proc-btn appears with review-<id> button (pending_admin).
test_results.procurement_admin_approve_skips_to_appro: PASS - Admin clicks Review → act-approve → act-submit; because project has no management user assigned, status advances directly to 'Approved' and 'Issue PO' (po-<id>) button becomes visible. Verified on VVC project (same code path as CVF; both projects lack a management user).
test_results.units_project_switch: PASS - data-testid=project-switch present with one button per project; only one project's inventory rendered at a time.
test_results.units_view_report_admin: PASS - CVF plot 32 (SOLD) shows view-report-32 icon; clicking opens Modal 'Payment report · Plot 32' with report-iframe and report-download button; no error state shown; PDF blob loads in iframe.
test_results.units_view_report_post_sales: PASS - Post Sales user (9000000001) also sees view-report-32 on /units.
test_results.sales_view_report_button: PASS - /sales plot-pay-row-32 drilldown modal footer has view-report-<unitId> AND download-report-<unitId> buttons; clicking View opens the ReportViewer modal with report-iframe.
test_results.projects_switch: PASS - /projects shows data-testid=project-switch and single ProjectCard visible.
test_results.team_all_projects_column: PASS - /users renders 'All projects' in Projects column for non project-scoped roles (Admin/Accounts/Post Sales). Count=3 rows in seed.
test_results.no_console_errors: PASS - No page errors captured during navigation across login, procurement, units, projects, sales, users.

critical_code_review_comments: ReportViewer.jsx correctly revokes object URL on unmount and shows loading/error states.
Procurement.jsx REACHED map is consistent with new STAGES order (pending_admin=1, pending_management=2, approved=3).

Units.jsx canReport gate: user.role !== 'site_manager' && status==='sold' — correctly excludes site_manager; management-role gating for the /units/<id>/payment-report endpoint is enforced server-side (per notes).
Auto-logout inactivity effect not exercised (per instructions); confirmed pages load without effect-related errors.
